verdicts.evidence: Argued with a measured sensitivity control, not supposed. On every reachable input the guard is dead code: rulesDir() returns the mission's runward/rules only when existsSync says it exists, else the package's templates/rules, which the npm files list ships ('templates' in package.json files) — measured identical signature maps, pristine vs mutated, on a corpus holding a signed rule, an unsigned rule and an unreadable (chmod 000) rule. The one divergent neighbour is an install whose templates/rules is GONE combined with a mission carrying no local rules: built that twin (dist copy whose package root has an empty templates/) — pristine returns {}, mutated throws ENOENT from readdirSync. That input is unreachable in operation, and even there the verdict does not move: on the same broken install expectedRules/allRules return [] through their own unmutated copies of this guard, so the mapping floor (ADR-0002) already turns the run red — exit 1 with a report from the pristine build, exit 1 with a stack trace from the mutated one. No input a gate can meet makes the two forms disagree on a verdict.

verdicts.evidence: The initializer is dead on every path, and the only path that could expose it was probed. The try's single statement either assigns sig — parseRuleMeta always returns a string signature, '(fm.match(...)?.[1] ?? "").trim()', it cannot return undefined — or throws before assigning, and the catch 'continue's the loop, so 'if (sig)' never reads the initializer. SENSITIVITY CONTROL: the divergent neighbour is an iteration that reaches 'if (sig)' with the initializer intact, which requires the try to complete without assigning — impossible, the assignment IS the try body; the only way the initializer survives to the guard is if the catch stops continuing, which is mutant 8's edit, adjudicated separately (only the PAIR diverges). MEASURED 2026-08-27 on a rules corpus whose unreadable file (chmod 000) drives the throwing path: pristine and mutated builds return the identical map, the unreadable file absent from both.

verdicts.evidence: When the read throws, sig still holds its initializer "" — the assignment never completed — so control falling out of the emptied catch reaches 'if (sig)' with a falsy value and the file is skipped: the same observable state 'continue' produces, one line later. SENSITIVITY CONTROL: divergence requires sig to be truthy at catch entry, and under this mutant alone no input can arrange that — "" is the only value sig can hold when the try throws (readFileSync throws before parseRuleMeta runs on an unreadable file or a directory named *.md); the truthy initializer that would flip it is mutant 7's edit, a different mutant. MEASURED 2026-08-27 on the corpus with a chmod-000 rule file: pristine and mutated builds return the identical signature map, the unreadable file excluded from both.

verdicts.evidence: RWD-2026-0082's territory: a mutant that falsifies the signature-map keying and extinguishes the regex screen. The unanchored replace cuts the FIRST '.md' out of the filename instead of the extension: MEASURED, ruleSignatures keys 'house-screen.mdlint.md' as 'house-screenlint.md' under the mutant, while every other reader of the corpus (expectedRules, allRules, both still anchored on /\.md$/) slugs it 'house-screen.mdlint' — so the evidence layer's lookup signatures[row.rule] (evidence.js, ADR-0020) finds nothing and the shape check on that rule's applied evidence silently disappears. RECIPE (2026-08-27): shipped example + vendored locked rules + signed CRITICAL house rule 'house-screen.mdlint.md' (signature: NEVER_PRESENT_TOKEN_ZQX, phases [architect]) + manifest row '| house-screen.mdlint | applied | file:code/src/demo.ts |' whose target lacks the token. Shipped build: exit 1, '✗ Architect · house-screen.mdlint — evidence does not match the rule's signature /NEVER_PRESENT_TOKEN_ZQX/i'. Mutated build: exit 0. A verdict flip to green on evidence the gate was told to shape-check. Why nothing sees it: every rule file in the shipped corpus and in every leg's fixture carries a single '.md', so the anchored and unanchored replaces agree there — all six full-net legs plus the self-gate replayed against the mutated build: PASS.
